stem:
A marble rolls along a metre scale without turning aside.

How should that motion be classified?

options.text: Oscillatory, because all school motions are to-and-fro.
Linear: the path is a straight line.
Not motion, because it is slow.
Circular, because the marble is round.

teacher.key_rationale: A straight path is linear motion. Round shape and slowness do not change that class.
